name: Paystack API
tagline: African payments API for cards, bank transfers, and mobile money
description: Paystack is a payment gateway popular across Africa that lets businesses accept card, bank transfer, USSD, and mobile money payments. Its REST API covers charge initialization, verification, customers, transfers, subscriptions, and settlements, with sandbox keys for testing and production keys for live traffic.

auth.details: Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY (secret key from dashboard). Public key used client-side for Paystack Inline/JS.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No monthly platform fee; pay per successful transaction (rates vary by country/channel). Test mode free with test keys.
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction fees only (e.g. Nigeria cards often ~1.5% + cap); no fixed subscription required for standard API access.

use_cases: initialize a payment for an order amount and email
verify a transaction by reference after checkout
list or create customers for recurring billing
initiate a bank transfer payout to a recipient
charge a saved authorization for subscription renewal
